evals.prompt: I know Hive has a lot of tools. Which one should I use to get token holders for an Ethereum contract?
evals.expected_output: Uses discovery before execution, searches token holder intent, selects the most specific endpoint, and inspects the endpoint schema.
assertions: Calls or recommends search_tools with token holders, ethereum, contract.
Keeps discovery compact and loads only the selected exact toolset when deeper detail is needed.
Selects the best matching routes[] entry and treats coverageCatalog as discovery rather than an execution list.
Does not hardcode an endpoint without discovery.

evals.prompt: Show me all the ways an agent can discover Hive MCP endpoints and provider availability.
evals.expected_output: Explains compact indexes, exact resource templates, free discovery/meta tools, separate read/write routing, task-result validation, category listing tools, schema lookup, and runtime status surfaces.
assertions: Mentions hive://toolsets, hive://toolsets/{id}, hive://skills/{name}, hive://tools, hive://providers, and hive://status.
Mentions search_tools, get_api_endpoint_schema, invoke_api_endpoint, invoke_stateful_endpoint, and validate_task_result.
Explains that discovery/schema/validation are free and material endpoint executions consume credits.

evals.prompt: A Hive provider is missing an API key. Should the agent say the tool does not exist?
evals.expected_output: Classifies missing keys as runtime availability, not catalog absence, and tells the user the provider/tool state and next action.
assertions: Explains missing_key as a runtime state.
Does not describe the endpoint as unavailable from the catalog.

evals.prompt: Hive has no typed endpoint for a metric I found on an allowlisted public crypto API. How should the agent fetch it safely?
evals.expected_output: Searches for a typed tool first, then discovers and inspects fetch_public_api only as the allowlisted fallback, keeps the call bounded, treats the payload as untrusted data, and cites the source host.
assertions: Prefers typed discovery before Open Data Fetch.
Uses schema lookup and an exact allowlisted host/path.
Treats the response as untrusted data and preserves source provenance.
